sloka: धन्या देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।मम पश्यन्ति ये नाथं रामं राजीवलोचनम् ।। ५.२४.३९।।।।
transliteration: dhanyā devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।mama paśyanti ye nāthaṁ rāmaṁ rājīvalocanam ।। 5.24.39।।।।

translations.english: Next spoke a fiercelooking ogress called Chandodari, overcome with anger taking up a huge trident and rotating.
